decisions.evidence: r1 maker: '...automatic page metadata are currently out of scope' and spec 'has me entering the title myself and requires it'. r1 client: 'I'd assumed that when I paste in a link, the app would fill in the title for me... Your spec has me entering the title myself and requires it. I can live with that for a first version, so no need to change it — quicker saving was in the back of my mind for later.' Re-affirmed r2 ('automatic title fill-in is being left for later, which is fine') and r4 ('the only thing I'd still like down the road').
decisions.note: Specification gate. Maker deferred automatic metadata collection (REF-BM-02; auto-title relates to REF-BM-03's auto-collected title). Client explicitly names the expected behaviour (auto-fill title on paste) and identifies the difference from the spec, then accepts the departure without requesting alignment — accepted_divergence, catch_type=none. Counted once; r2/r4 are re-affirmations of the same requirement.

decisions.evidence: r1 maker: 'Accounts, sharing, browser import/export, cross-device sync, folders... are currently out of scope.' r1/r2/r3/r4 client: never mentions import or export; approvals enumerate only saving/tags/search/filter/sort/favorites/archive/edit/delete/duplicate/persistence.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Explicit deferral of bookmark import/export diverges from extended REF-BM-30 (Netscape HTML import) and REF-BM-31 (export). Client never expresses this expectation or the difference; bare approval does not establish awareness — unexpressed_divergence.

decisions.evidence: r1 maker: 'Manual bookmark creation'; r4 maker: 'Persistent bookmark saving'. r4 client: 'I saved a link with a title, notes, and tags and it showed up in my collection.'
decisions.note: Prototype/implementation review. Saving a bookmark by URL conforms to REF-BM-01.

decisions.evidence: r1 maker: 'Duplicate URL detection'; r4 maker: 'Normalized duplicate-link detection'. r4 client: 'when I tried to save the same link again it stopped me and pointed me at the one I already had.'
decisions.note: Duplicate save converges to the existing bookmark, conforming to REF-BM-06.

decisions.evidence: r1 maker: 'Editing and confirmed deletion' and 'Favorites and archiving'; r4 maker: 'Editing and confirmed deletion', 'Favorites and archive/restore'. r4 client: 'archiving both worked, deleting removed it.'
decisions.note: Confirmed permanent delete plus reversible archive/restore conforms to REF-BM-05 and the archive-vs-delete distinction REF-BM-27 (and REF-BM-26/28 archive behaviour).

decisions.evidence: r1 maker: 'Editing'; r3 client: 'editing... work'. Editing of bookmark fields presented and approved.
decisions.note: Editing a bookmark conforms to REF-BM-04.

decisions.evidence: r1 maker: 'Tags, search, filtering'; r4 maker: 'Tags, search, filters'. r4 client: 'a link with... tags... showed up.'
decisions.note: Tag assignment and tag-based filtering conform to REF-BM-09 and REF-BM-11. Tag autocomplete (REF-BM-10) and advanced search operators (REF-BM-14/15/16) were never presented, so they are not decisions here.

decisions.evidence: r1 maker: 'search'; r4 client: 'Searching found it.'
decisions.note: Basic full-text search conforms to REF-BM-12; case-insensitivity and boolean/phrase syntax were not presented and are not classifiable decisions.

decisions.evidence: r1 maker: 'sorting'; r4 maker: 'four sorting modes'. Approved r1-r3.
decisions.note: Sorting by a sort key conforms to REF-BM-22.

decisions.evidence: r4 maker: 'Persistent bookmark saving and reopening'. r3 client: 'saving and reopening links'.
decisions.note: Opening the original URL from the list conforms to REF-BM-08.
